-- True when the path stays inside the notes directory:
-- no "..", no absolute path, nothing that climbs out.
safe_path(path: str) -> bool =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  ex safe_path("a.txt") == True
  ex safe_path("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex safe_path("../x.txt") == False
  ex safe_path("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex safe_path("sub/../../x") == False
  var depth = 0
  let parts = path.split("/")
  for i in range(0, parts.len())
    let p = parts[i]
    if i == 0 and p == ""
      return False
    if p == "" or p == "."
      continue
    if p == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  True

-- Text of notes/path, or "" when the path escapes notes or the file
-- is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post safe_path(path) or out == ""
  ex read_public("missing-file-xyz.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  if not safe_path(path)
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    return fs.read(path) else ""
